Name: A Second Vat
Description: A second lagering vat for the Cooling cellar.
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony: an achievement only grants the RIGHT to buy an upgrade; you buy it at the Club House). ONE ROW PER UPGRADE. Achievement = the ID of a row of data/Achievements.csv - once that achievement is earned the upgrade is for sale. Blank = for sale from the start. Needs = any extra condition in the usual language (unlocked:x, count:x>=n). Cost and Currency use data/Currencies.csv. Effect is the ordinary effects language: count:batches_<section>+1 is a Brewery vat, count:tune_<any Tuning row>+n raises a number, unlock:x opens a thing. Each upgrade is bought once. WAS a free Reward on the A Second Vat achievement
